beginner.opening: Welcome. Tell me one simple thing about yourself, like your name and what you do.
follow_ups: What do you do at work?
practice_sentences: I have two years of work experience.

basic.opening: Welcome. Tell me about one experience you are proud of.
follow_ups: What was the most challenging part of that experience?
What did you learn from it?
practice_sentences: I have three years of experience in software development.
I am good at solving technical problems.

intermediate.opening: Welcome. Walk me through one achievement and how you contributed to it.
follow_ups: How did you measure the impact of that achievement?
What would you do differently next time?
practice_sentences: I led a team that improved delivery speed by thirty percent.
I resolved a critical production issue that saved the company time and money.
